models_evaluated: MONAI Deploy Express slice-to-volume reconstruction pipeline

links.outcome: Radiologist-rated quality of reconstructed outputs on real examinations
links.effect: Three fellowship-trained fetal radiologists independently scored reconstructions; brain SVR pass-or-higher in 59/65 (90.8%), body 57/65 (87.7%); ICC 0.93 brain, 0.92 body.
links.quote: Brain SVR was rated pass-or-higher in 59/65 examinations (90.8%) and body SVR was rated pass-or-higher in 57/65 examinations (87.7%).

unlisted_practices: Vendor-neutral DICOM-routing deployment architecture for AI integration into PACS

screen.reason: The study evaluates the operational reliability, workflow integration (DICOM/PACS routing via MONAI Deploy), and clinical acceptability of an automated fetal MRI reconstruction pipeline in a production clinical setting.
